summary: Diageo plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Fiscal 27 Q1 trading statement for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, a routine earnings release rather than a special situation. Reported net sales rose 1.2% to $4.9bn; organic net sales grew 0.6% excluding EABL, with volume -0.1% and price/mix +0.7%. North America declined mid-single-digit, offset by mid-single-digit growth in Latin America and Asia Pacific. Full-year guidance was unchanged, and CEO Sir Dave Lewis hosted a presentation and Q&A. Watch for progress on the EABL and Royal Challengers Bengaluru transactions and North America share recovery.
